name: Dollar-cost average schedule
summary: Split a total cash amount across N equal buys and show shares per slice at a study price.
author: friday-core
description: Informational analysis, education, or calculation only. FRIDAY has no brokerage or exchange connection and cannot place, execute, or automate a real trade. Each slice = total/periods. Shares per slice = slice/price. A worksheet, not an auto-invest instruction.
